description: BW-only diagnostic matrix for the continuous-LoRa Sobel example. Two orthogonal axes: class-BW vs GT BW (augmentation/alias axis, split by scaling direction) and measured BW vs GT BW (bounding-box height quality axis). No SF conditions: SF misclassification is delegated to mAP metrics. Cells are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.

class_sf.label: Nominal class SF (detected vs GT SF)

class_bw.label: Nominal class BW (detected vs GT BW)

measured_bw.label: Measured BW (box estimate vs GT BW)

rows.class_ok: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10

columns.measured_ok: abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10
columns.measured_off: abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') > 0.10
